offers_products.reason: Sells toll, violation and title/registration technology platforms and camera enforcement systems; software and data count as products.

offers_services.reason: Installs, maintains and manages red-light, speed and school bus camera programs for municipalities; manages tolls and violations for fleets.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are rental car companies, fleet operators, municipalities, school districts and toll authorities, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Rental car companies, fleet management companies, municipalities, school districts and OEMs are the main buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing toll and violation management per rental or fleet vehicle, plus multi-year camera program contracts with governments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Government safety enforcement programs and toll or violation processing continue in downturns; rental volumes cause only mild sensitivity.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue is per-transaction toll and violation fees and recurring program fees, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for technology platforms, data and camera systems rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Major rental car companies, large fleet operators, fleet management companies and city governments are the main customers.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology-led business; camera equipment is deployed, but it does not need plants, fleets or networks of heavy scale.

notes: Camera equipment is owned and deployed under government contracts, so asset intensity is moderate.
